purpose.primary: Study the observable psychology-like behavior of artificial systems, especially large language models and agents.
purpose.short_definition: Machine psychology as experimental study of recurrent, measurable machine behavior under controlled stimuli.
scope: conformity, majority pressure and minority-truth failure
goal stability, goal misgeneralization and instrumental behavior
hidden/non-semantic trait transmission between teacher and student models
synthetic-data behavioral inheritance and distillation pathologies
machine cultural transmission across serial interactions and model generations
population conventions, cultural attractors and generational bias amplification
